senses.gloss: f. (כמם, v. כמן; cmp. Arab. kummath, Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. II, 450ᵇ) skull-cap, worn under the turban (סוּדְרָא).
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 84b:6">Erub. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>דילמא כשהרבים … בכ׳ וסודרא</he> perhaps the public use of them (the low roofs) refers to people putting their cap and turban on them? <cite ref="Eruvin 91a:13">Ib. 91ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>בכ׳ וס׳</he> it may be possible with cap &c. (by putting them on in the house and taking them off in the court).
<cite ref="Moed Katan 15a:9">M. Kat. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>אכ׳ וס׳</he> it refers to (the mourner’s) cap and turban.
<cite ref="Gittin 39b:15">Gitt. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>שקל כּוּמְתֵיה וכ׳</he> he took his cap and threw it at her.
<cite ref="Shabbat 147a:3">Sabb. 147ᵃ</cite> <he>הב לי כּוּמְתָאִי</he> hand me my cap.
